name: ApprovalTask
caption: Approval task

edges.rules: Exactly two edges in this order: edges[0] value "true" (approved) and edges[1] value "false" (rejected), the same values as Decision and Confirm dialog. The engine routes on the 'result' output. An edge with no steps continues after the step.

configuration.description: What the approver should check. Shown on the task card. Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. The task's subject is the step's description (fallback: the flow's description), not this text.
0 = a single user, 1 = a task group (any member can decide). The editor always writes it. Any value other than 1 is treated as a user.

assignType 0: a Business Central user name (or user security ID). assignType 1: a task group code. Matched case-insensitively after trimming. Can be a SmartField that holds the name or code, resolved when the step runs. The user must exist and be enabled; assignees need no AutoFlow Tasks seat.

Task group only: how many different members must approve. Values below 1 count as 1. More than 1 needs assignType 1, and the group needs at least that many members. One rejection rejects the task right away.

Optional. A date (yyyy-mm-dd is safest) or a SmartDate such as [[TODAY+5D]]. Overdue tasks are highlighted in the inbox and can be sent as a digest. A value that does not resolve to a date is ignored silently (no due date).
Rows of { type, reference, url, caption } shown on the task card. The editor always writes the array ([] when empty).

record = a Business Central record the approver can open; document = a file the approver can preview and download (an AutoFlow document or an Incoming Document Attachment); link = a URL. Any other value makes the row be skipped.

record / document rows: exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to a reference, an array or an iterator, read in its raw form. Each record it holds becomes one attachment. A row that resolves to no record is skipped without error.
link rows: the URL. SmartText. If it is exactly one placeholder that holds an array of values, each value becomes one link. An empty URL is skipped.
Caption shown for the attachment. SmartText. Used for every attachment the row produces.

outputs.name: result
outputs.when: once decided - "true" (approved) or "false" (rejected); the engine routes on it

outputs.name: comment
outputs.when: once decided - approved: every approver's comment joined with '; '; rejected: the rejecting comment (always present, a rejection needs one)

outputs.name: decidedBy
outputs.when: once decided - approved: the approvers' user names joined with ', '; rejected: the rejecting user

outputs.name: task
outputs.when: once decided - the task record (table 5564323 mse365 AF-CO Task), for linking or reporting

notes: Dark-launched: only available where AutoFlow Tasks (portal feature flag 'tasks') is enabled for the environment. Elsewhere the step is hidden in the editor and publish refuses it.

The flow waits in the background. The first run creates the task and parks the execution; it is checked again every poll interval (AutoFlow Setup 'Task Poll Interval (Min.)', default 5 minutes). When the user the flow runs as decides the task themselves, the run continues immediately. No session is held while waiting, so a task can stay open for days.
Each pass of a loop creates its own task. A retried or restarted run finds the task it already created instead of creating a second one.
In a Webhook flow with WaitForResponse, put the step after Respond to Webhook: in the synchronous phase the step cannot park and fails.
Assignees need no AutoFlow Tasks seat, but deciding an approval needs a paid AutoFlow licence. Rejecting needs a comment.
requiredApprovals > 1: the task completes when that many different members approved; the first rejection rejects it.

The task is shown in the AutoFlow task inbox. The assignee (plus their delegate while they are out of office) or every group member gets an e-mail, unless they turned new-task e-mails off in their task settings.
